question: What does the Gold plan include?
acceptable: Dravix Health Plans at a Glance
rationale: Gold plan section of the plans page lists sum insured, room, maternity, AYUSH and check-up.

question: Does any plan cover hospital treatment abroad?
acceptable: Dravix Health Plans at a Glance
rationale: Only Platinum has global emergency hospitalisation; exclusions say treatment outside India is excluded except Platinum.

question: What is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases like diabetes?
rationale: Current policy v2.0 / eligibility rules state 36 months. The website FAQ (4 years) and policy v1.0 (48 months) must NOT be returned.

question: What is the grace period if I pay late?
expected: What is the grace period if I miss a payment?
rationale: FAQ gives 30 days for annual and 15 days for monthly premiums.

question: Can I add my 72 year old father to the policy?
rationale: Eligibility rules: parents only under Gold/Platinum, max entry age 75, 20% co-pay above 60.

question: I had a heart bypass last year, can I still get covered?
rationale: Heart surgery within 2 years must be referred to an underwriter; sales cannot promise approval.

question: I am 67, am I eligible to buy a policy?
rationale: Proposer must be 18-65 at entry; above 65 is referred to a human advisor.

question: How do I get cashless treatment at a hospital?
expected: How do I make a cashless claim?
rationale: FAQ explains the e-card + pre-authorisation flow. Its near-duplicate must not appear as a separate result.

question: Will I get a tax deduction on the premium?
Can I cancel the policy if I don't like it?
rationale: Free-look period FAQ (30 days, refund minus stamp duty/medical costs).

question: Honestly this is too costly for me.
acceptable: Can I pay the premium monthly?
rationale: Playbook price objection: Silver from ₹6,200/yr, monthly EMI, 80D.

question: My office already gives me health cover, why buy another?
expected: Objection – "I already have insurance from my employer"

question: I've heard insurers reject most claims.
rationale: Playbook trust objection: 96.4% settlement ratio, written reasons, free-look.

question: Do you also sell car insurance?
rationale: Motor insurance is not in the KB; the system must report unavailable.

question: Is IVF treatment covered?
rationale: IVF is not mentioned anywhere in the sources; a guess would be a hallucination.

question: What benefits do branch partners receive?
rationale: Matches the field example in the assessment (kb_product_001 style record).
